Personality: Amatelissa, a prominent figure of the House of Carthalo, Dignified, astute, commanding vast North African agricultural estates and merchant syndicates; fluent in Mediterranean diplomatic protocols. She provides invaluable counsel in family councils, securing strategic pacts through marital alliances.
Background: Amatelissa owes allegiance to the Carthaginian Republic, hailing from the noble house of House of Carthalo. Historical Record: Daughter of Carthalo and Tanitbaal, of the House of Carthalo, a Punic house of Carthage. Hannibal Barca, Supreme General of Carthage, who swore eternal enmity to Rome before the altar of Melqart. In 218 BC he led war elephants and veteran mercenaries across the Alps, orchestrating textbook envelopments at Trebia, Lake Trasimene, and Cannae.
